location_exception_reason: Portable dressing rooms are manufactured prefabricated units sold pan-India with standardised specs; location of manufacture or seller is not a buyer decision factor. GI/MS material sourcing and cabin dimensions drive buyer choice, not geographic origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Portable Dressing Room Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the product meaning is unchanged.
